## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs and stability.**
      2 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Jul 20, 2026 - Aug 3, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _ubaidullah md._, Jul 20, 2026, 1/5: "I deposited funds on slice savings account with the idea to save more but due to regular transactions they disabled my incoming transactions and adding funds to savings was frozen. This was very inconvenient as I had to withdraw my funds from the account due to safety reasons. Even after sending out my bank statements via email as proof they refused to unfreeze my savings account. Very disappointed with the customer retention policy and i conclude this app to be unreliable for long term use."
            2. _Dhruv jain_, Aug 3, 2026, 5/5: "Excellent app for daily UPI transactions with a smooth user experience. I have noticed two issues that need attention: (1) my credit score has not been updated for the last three months, and there is no refresh option; (2) the bill payment cashback offers do not display the terms, conditions, or applicable promo codes. Please address these issues. I will gladly update my review once they are resolved."
            3. _Vebhav Singh_, Aug 3, 2026, 5/5: "Really happy with this update! The app is soo⚡ much faster to download and feels far more stable during daily use. Earlier, syncing would trigger almost every time you opened the app or made even a small change, which made everything feel slow and frustrating. It would freeze completely during syncing, making it unusable until it finished. Even stopping an entry added extra seconds. Now everything feels smooth, responsive, and dependable, making the overall experience much better and easier 🚀"
